card.name: "For" before storage time limits
card.fires_on: The word "for" (or "a") right after a storage temperature, such as 2°C to 8°C (36°F to 46°F), where a maximum hold time comes next, like "up to 24 hours".

modes.label: "for" after temperature
modes.description: The word "for" follows a refrigeration temperature range and leads into a time limit.
modes.example: refrigerate the diluted solution at 2°C to 8°C (36°F to 46°F)<< for>> no more than 4 hours.

modes.description: The word "a" appears in "for a maximum of" before a hold time.
